description: This file defines an abstract generic collection class that bridges a Map source with the Collection interface, allowing for custom iteration and collection operations.

classes.name: GenericMapCollection
classes.description: An abstract class that adapts a Map to a Collection of its interface, supporting collection operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Unsupported operation; adding elements directly is not allowed.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Unsupported operation; adding multiple elements directly is not allowed.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks whether all elements in a collection are contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the source map is empty.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the collection, default calls an abstract method.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements in a given collection from this collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in this collection that are contained in the specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the source map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts collection to an Object array.

methods.name: toArray (generic version)
methods.description: Converts collection to an array of a specified type.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Helper method to build string representation of the collection.
